definitions: A movement in which something swings.
A seat hung by ropes or chains, on which someone can sit and swing backwards and forwards.
A style of jazz music, popular especially in the 1930s and 1940s, characterized by a strong rhythm and a prominent saxophone section.
A noticeable change or shift in opinion, mood, or circumstances.
The manner in which a golf club or other implement is swung.
examples: The swing of the pendulum was hypnotic.
The children played on the swing in the park.
They danced to the sound of swing music.
There was a big swing in public opinion.
